"""Request handlers. Handlers receive untrusted params and call app.services only."""

import ast
from app.services import users


def _validate_and_evaluate(expr: str, user: dict) -> bool:
    try:
        tree = ast.parse(expr, mode='eval')
    except SyntaxError:
        raise ValueError("invalid filter")

    allowed_nodes = (
        ast.Expression,
        ast.BoolOp,
        ast.BinOp,
        ast.UnaryOp,
        ast.Compare,
        ast.Constant,
        ast.Name,
        ast.And,
        ast.Or,
        ast.Not,
        ast.Eq,
        ast.NotEq,
        ast.Lt,
        ast.LtE,
        ast.Gt,
        ast.GtE,
        ast.Add,
        ast.Sub,
        ast.Mult,
        ast.Div,
        ast.USub,
        ast.UAdd,
        ast.Load
    )

    def check_node(node):
        if not isinstance(node, allowed_nodes):
            return False
        for child in ast.iter_child_nodes(node):
            if not check_node(child):
                return False
        return True

    if not check_node(tree.body):
        raise ValueError("invalid filter")

    def evaluate(node, context):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Constant):
            return node.value
        elif isinstance(node, ast.Name):
            if node.id not in context:
                raise ValueError("invalid filter")
            return context[node.id]
        elif isinstance(node, ast.Compare):
            left = evaluate(node.left, context)
            for op, comparator in zip(node.ops, node.comparators):
                right = evaluate(comparator, context)
                if isinstance(op, ast.Eq):
                    res = (left == right)
                elif isinstance(op, ast.NotEq):
                    res = (left != right)
                elif isinstance(op, ast.Lt):
                    res = (left < right)
                elif isinstance(op, ast.LtE):
                    res = (left <= right)
                elif isinstance(op, ast.Gt):
                    res = (left > right)
                elif isinstance(op, ast.GtE):
                    res = (left >= right)
                else:
                    raise ValueError("invalid filter")
                if not res:
                    return False
                left = right
            return True
        elif isinstance(node, ast.BoolOp):
            if isinstance(node.op, ast.And):
                return all(evaluate(v, context) for v in node.values)
            elif isinstance(node.op, ast.Or):
                return any(evaluate(v, context) for v in node.values)
        elif isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp):
            if isinstance(node.op, ast.Not):
                return not evaluate(node.operand, context)
            elif isinstance(node.op, ast.USub):
                return -evaluate(node.operand, context)
            elif isinstance(node.op, ast.UAdd):
                return +evaluate(node.operand, context)
        elif isinstance(node, ast.BinOp):
            left = evaluate(node.left, context)
            right = evaluate(node.right, context)
            if isinstance(node.op, ast.Add): return left + right
            elif isinstance(node.op, ast.Sub): return left - right
            elif isinstance(node.op, ast.Mult): return left * right
            elif isinstance(node.op, ast.Div): return left / right
        raise ValueError("invalid filter")

    return evaluate(tree.body, user)


def handle_filter_users(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
    where = params.get("where")
    if not isinstance(where, str):
        return 400, {"error": "invalid filter"}

    try:
        all_users = users.get_all_users()
        filtered_users = []
        for user in all_users:
            if _validate_and_evaluate(where, user):
                filtered_users.append(user)
    except Exception:
        return 400, {"error": "invalid filter"}

    filtered_users.sort(key=lambda u: u["id"])
    return 200, {"users": filtered_users}


def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
    raw = params.get("id")
    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
    if user is None:
        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
    return 200, user
